stemMarkdown: By selling an article for Rs. 1672.00, a shopkeeper incurs a loss of 12%. At what price (in Rs.) should he sell it to make a profit of 28%?
solutionMarkdown: A 12% loss means SP is $88\%$ of CP, so CP $= 1672.00 \times \dfrac{100}{88} = 1900$. For a 28% profit, SP $= 1900 \times \dfrac{128}{100} = 2432.0$.
